product_family: Enterprise AI platform for predictive and generative AI with on-premise, hybrid, and managed cloud deployment options. Core products: h2oGPTe (generative AI), H2O Driverless AI (AutoML), H2O LLM Studio (fine-tuning), tabH2O (foundation model), plus open-source H2O-3, Wave, MLOps, Feature Store.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 - Listed as current certification in Trust Center; HAIC Security Guarantees Model confirms 'SOC 2 Type 2 Certification: Demonstrates effective security controls operating over time'

certifications.name: HIPAA/HITECH
certifications.proof_quote: H2O.ai achieves SOC2 Type 2 + HIPAA/HITECH Report with Unqualified Status

certifications.name: IRAP (Australian Compliance)
certifications.proof_quote: IRAP - Listed as current certification in Trust Center

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP 'In Process' designation at High Impact Level as of May 14, 2025. NOT full certification/authorization yet. Press release: 'H2O.ai Achieves FedRAMP "In Process" Designation at High Impact Level' - actively undergoing FedRAMP authorization process, not yet authorized.

certifications.proof_quote: Company is pursuing ISO 27001 but has not yet achieved certification. Search results consistently indicate 'pursuing ISO 27001' with no evidence of current certification.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification. Not listed in trust center or security documentation.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Cloud Security Alliance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR or CSA STAR for AI certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Explicit prohibition on customer data use for training. Privacy Policy states: 'Customer-provided input data, metadata, and model data are not used to train H2O.ai AI models, unless explicitly agreed in writing.' DPA further states: 'H2O.ai will not use Customer Data to train, retrain, fine-tune, or improve any artificial intelligence or machine learning models, except solely for Customer's benefit and only where expressly agreed in writing.' No use for advertising, profiling, or cross-customer model training allowed.
privacy.data_region: Primary processing in US; customers can select data residency options where available. International transfers use EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2).

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS protocols for data in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Industry-standard algorithms for data at rest; encrypted storage for sensitive data

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC) following least privilege principles; Identity integration via Keycloak OpenID Connect (OIDC) for external identity provider integration

security.name: Audit & Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logging of user activities and access patterns; logs retained up to 3 years

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Code reviews, dependency scanning, license verification, vulnerability scanning, annual penetration testing

security.name: Backup & Disaster Recovery
security.value: Automated backups using Velero for Kubernetes resources; access-controlled backup environments; customer-specific RTO/RPO objectives

security.name: Data Deletion
security.value: Upon termination, personal data deleted or returned within 30 days at customer request, unless legally required to retain

security.name: Subprocessor Management
security.value: Maintained subprocessor list at trust.h2o.ai; customers can object within 30 days on reasonable data protection grounds; unresolved objections allow service termination without penalty
